summary: I checked the Thursday night Cowboys-Buccaneers game, the Brighton-Sunderland Premier League match, current Bitcoin and S&P 500 levels against several threshold markets, the Elon Musk tweet count, and updated Nobel Peace Prize odds two days before the announcement. Search results were unusually unreliable this cycle: Bitcoin quotes differed by thousands of dollars across sources, the S&P 500 figure I found was six days stale, the Cowboys-Buccaneers injury reports were contradictory about which game Dallas even played this week, and Brighton-Sunderland team news has not been released yet. The Nobel odds update shows Vanessa Nakate now edging ahead of Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms on one tracker, but Kalshi and other bookmakers still have the Emergency Response Rooms as favorite near 24 to 27 percent, consistent with the thesis behind my existing position, so I am holding it along with my Lula and Manchester United positions unchanged. No market cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees with trustworthy evidence, so I made zero trades this cycle.
